scope: Fifteen new dedicated avatars plus existing generated Kaito portrait. Runtime acceptance tracked in docs/wiki/Native-Animation-Audit.md.

prompts.akio: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE dedicated 2D fighting-game roster/HUD avatar portrait for akio. The supplied full-body pixel-art image is the exact identity and costume reference. Create a head-and-upper-shoulders portrait of that SAME adult character. Preserve gender, face shape, hair color/style, complexion, facial hair, mask/helmet/visor, horns, head ornaments and costume colors exactly as applicable in reference. No reimagining identity or adding accessories. For masked/robotic characters KEEP mask/helmet/visor ON. For female characters preserve feminine adult appearance. Head fills center, readable eyes or visor, slight three-quarter view facing right. Keep complete hair/horns/helmet inside square canvas with generous top and side transparent margins; allow long hair to flow behind shoulders without hiding face. Crisp modern arcade pixel art with deliberate pixel clusters, clean selective outlines and controlled palette shading; no painterly blur or 3D. Match detail level across the roster. Transparent background with actual alpha, no glow or aura around silhouette, no scenery, no text/logos/borders, no weapons blocking face. One portrait only, not a sheet, no full body. Square512x512 if possible.
